ideas.idea: Give /blog server-rendered metadata (title/description) by splitting into a server page plus client component
ideas.why: The blog has no metadata of its own and inherits the home page's title and description, which the files confirm.
This repeats the known /docs canonical problem and the known blog client-component problem, so it adds little beyond what is already graded.

ideas.idea: Resolve the pricing noindex conflict: remove index:false, or else remove it from the sitemap and navigation/canonical
ideas.why: This is the known pricing noindex problem restated, with a conditional fix.

ideas.idea: Give each blog post its own page/URL instead of titles only from /api/posts
ideas.why: Posts render only as titles with no addresses, so individual posts can't be linked, indexed or cited.

ideas.idea: Expand the thin /docs content with setup steps
ideas.why: The docs page has one sentence while its description promises setup instructions for Ledger.
The page says only 'Free for up to three people' while its description promises plans for every team size.

ideas.idea: Add other training crawlers such as ClaudeBot to robots.txt to apply the trainingCrawlers: block policy
ideas.why: The policy says to block training crawlers but robots.txt names only GPTBot, so the policy is only partly applied.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to sitemap entries if real dates exist
ideas.why: This is accurate, but lastmod is a minor hint and applies to almost any sitemap.

ideas.idea: Add openGraph/social tags to shared pages
ideas.why: This is accurate but applies to nearly any site and has little effect on discovery or understanding.
